topics.topic: Ownership and constant access for MAX_PORT validation during service start
questions: Which module operation validates that `port` is no greater than `MAX_PORT`, and which module must import that constant?
Which capability owns checking that `port <= MAX_PORT`, and how may that capability obtain `MAX_PORT`?

quotes: load_config: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST raise ValueError when the port of the settings is above the imported MAX_PORT constant or when the time zone database does not know their timezone, then MUST call the imported load_connections once with the connections_file of the settings as a Path, letting its DelivererError end the start, and MUST return DeliveryContext with binary_root, state_dir and connections_file of the settings as Path values and their timezone unchanged; it MUST NOT read the credential file.
judgement.why: The later operation contract assigns the upper-bound check and the imported MAX_PORT constant to deliverer_service.load_config before it calls load_connections.
